native.window: Native titled, resizable workspace; default 1180 × 780pt, minimum 800 × 560pt. Source changes preserve window geometry. Stage Only hides controls and toolbar; Escape restores them.
native.surface: Regular material panels with 16pt corners and subtle inset edges. System under-page stage well. Reduce Transparency uses a solid control background; Increase Contrast strengthens edges. Unstyled capture has a transparent backdrop so native source corners reveal the stage well.
native.settings-actions: Tools stay open. One gear beside Tools and Command–comma open one native Settings window with a stable sidebar, six consistently named sections, and a governing On/Off switch per effect. The separate source widget includes state, pause/resume, clear, show controls, effects and settings.
native.source-layout: Resizable sidebar: 224pt initial width, 200–320pt range. Automatic compact rows below 680pt sidebar height, with no layout menu. Default thumbnails fit 16:9; compact previews are 64 × 40pt. Full titles appear in previews. Unavailable pins offer Unpin.

previewTranslation.status: Illustrative HTML/CSS only. Browser system colors, fonts, symbols, corners, and shadows approximate native rendering; no CSS value replaces Swift source. Sample content replaces real captured windows.
previewTranslation.units: One CSS px illustrates one macOS logical point. Frontmatter pt is not CSS pt.
previewTranslation.tonalRamps: Omitted because native semantic colors have no fixed authored ramp.

motion.name: compact-feedback
motion.value: SwiftUI easeOut: press 0.10s, hover 0.12s; press scale 0.96, opacity 0.82; preview dwell 450ms. Keyboard scrolling and source-state changes are immediate.
motion.purpose: Reduce Motion disables transitions and press scaling.

components.description: Illustrative CompactWindowButton; native source and system colors remain authoritative.

components.description: Unavailable slots retain identity and provide an adjacent recovery action.

components.description: Always-visible labeled effects share one settings gear in the Tools heading.

narrative.overview: One native window contains the presentation workspace. Tools sit above a vertically scrolling window list on the left. The source preview fills the remaining area at its own aspect ratio. A status strip below the stage contains current state, source title, Open Source App, Pause/Resume, and Clear Stage.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic system backgrounds, regular material, and SF system text.
Resizable source browsing with thumbnail and compact layouts.
Explicit capture controls and consistent native Settings.
Immediate keyboard navigation and restrained pointer feedback.
dos: Teach source selection → Stage Only → share BetterMeets.
Use “On stage” for local capture; BetterMeets does not know whether a meeting is transmitting the window.
Presenter controls show specific setup and recovery actions.
donts: Never imply that visible workspace controls are excluded from window sharing.
Audience placeholders stay brief and contain no raw error diagnostics or operator instructions.
